ABOUT THE COMPANY

Kantiv is a technology company revolutionizing the way professionals in the architecture, engineering, and construction (AEC) industry manage marketing and revenue operations. Our AI-powered software streamlines workflows, making it easier for teams to collaborate, innovate, and succeed.



ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Data Scientist to join our growing team and help build intelligent, data-driven solutions that power Kantiv’s AI platform. In this role, you will work with structured and unstructured data to uncover insights, develop agentic solutions, and improve the intelligence behind our products.

You will collaborate closely with backend engineers, AI engineers, and product teams to experiment with new approaches, solve real-world problems, and turn data into actionable insights. This is an exciting opportunity for someone early in their data science career who enjoys solving challenging problems, experimenting with AI technologies, and building solutions that create measurable business impact.



WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - AI Application Development: Build and improve AI-powered applications using LLMs, foundation models, and modern AI APIs to solve real-world product problems.

 - LLM Integration: Integrate commercial and open-source language models into applications, experimenting with prompting strategies, structured outputs, tool calling, and model selection.

 - RAG & Knowledge Systems: Develop retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines to help AI systems retrieve and reason over relevant information from documents, databases, and other unstructured data sources.

 - AI Agents & Workflows: Build and experiment with AI agents and multi-step workflows that use tools, access relevant context, and execute tasks with appropriate controls.

 - Data Processing & Retrieval: Develop pipelines for document ingestion, text extraction, chunking, embeddings, metadata management, and semantic search.

 - Evaluation & Reliability: Evaluate AI outputs for accuracy, relevance, consistency, and groundedness. Build test datasets and evaluation workflows to identify failure cases and improve system performance.

 - Backend Integration: Collaborate with backend engineers to integrate AI capabilities into APIs and existing product workflows, ensuring maintainability and reliability.

 - Performance & Cost Optimisation: Experiment with model selection, caching, retrieval strategies, and prompt optimisation to improve latency, reliability, and inference costs.

 - Monitoring & Debugging: Investigate issues in AI pipelines, troubleshoot unexpected model behaviour, and help monitor the quality and performance of AI-powered features.

 - Experimentation & Collaboration: Stay current with emerging AI techniques, evaluate relevant tools and frameworks, and work with product and engineering teams to translate customer problems into practical AI solutions.
   


WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - Experience: 1–3 years of experience in AI engineering, machine learning engineering, software engineering, or a related field. Strong internships and hands-on projects involving AI applications are also valuable.

 - Programming: Proficiency in Python and the ability to write clean, modular, maintainable code.

 - LLM Fundamentals: Understanding of how LLMs work at an application level, including prompting, context windows, token limits, structured outputs, and common failure modes.

 - RAG & Embeddings: Familiarity with embeddings, vector search, document retrieval, and the fundamentals of building RAG-based applications.

 - APIs & Backend Fundamentals: Experience working with REST APIs, JSON, asynchronous operations, and integrating external services into applications.

 - Data Handling: Ability to work with structured and unstructured data, using tools such as Pandas and SQL where appropriate.

 - Testing & Debugging: Ability to test application behaviour systematically, investigate failures, and improve the reliability of AI-driven workflows.

 - Problem-Solving: Strong analytical thinking and the ability to break down ambiguous problems into practical engineering solutions.

 - Collaboration: Clear communication skills, openness to feedback, and the ability to work effectively with engineers and product stakeholders.
   


EXPERIENCE WE’D BE PARTICULARLY EXCITED ABOUT

 - Production LLM Applications: Experience building and deploying LLM-powered applications beyond simple prompt-based prototypes.

 - Agentic Systems: Hands-on experimentation with AI agents, tool calling, function calling, or multi-step reasoning workflows.

 - AI Frameworks: Familiarity with frameworks and libraries such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or equivalent tools.

 - Vector Databases & Search: Experience with vector databases or search technologies such as pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, or Elasticsearch.

 - Evaluation & Observability: Exposure to LLM evaluation frameworks, tracing, monitoring, and tools for debugging AI workflows.

 - Cloud & Deployment: Familiarity with Docker, cloud platforms, deployment workflows, or serving AI applications in production.

 - Document Intelligence: Experience extracting information from PDFs, long-form documents, or complex business records.

 - B2B SaaS & Enterprise AI: Experience building AI capabilities for business users, particularly where accuracy, data security, and reliability matter.

 - AEC & Revenue Operations: Interest in applying AI to proposals, project information, client relationships, marketing, and revenue operations in the AEC industry.

ABOUT BASE

Base is America’s next-generation power company. We’re rebuilding the foundation of modern civilization–electricity–by deploying a vast network of distributed batteries that is transforming today’s fragile, centralized grid into a resilient and abundant system. We are engineers, operators, and creatives solving some of the most complex, interdisciplinary challenges of our time.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Base works in the physical world. A homeowner finds us and decides to trust a new kind of power company. A crew installs the battery. The city approves it, the utility connects it, and we dispatch it, telling it when to charge and when to send power back based on local grid conditions and the member’s usage. Our software has to work inside every one of those steps.

Now we’re going nationwide, and every new state is a new puzzle. The utilities and grids are different. Cities have their own rules. Homeowners think about batteries very differently, too: someone in Houston who lived through a week-long outage sees a home battery differently than someone who has never lost power. Launching a market means learning all of that fast, building software that works there, and then doing it again in the next state.

We’re hiring a forward deployed engineer to go where those problems are.



How this role works

You’ll embed with the teams and partners behind each launch and learn how their operations really run. Then you’ll build whatever it takes to make the launch work, from a partner’s spreadsheet to BaseOS to the firmware on the battery. What you learn goes back to our Core Experience and Platform teams, so every launch makes the system better.



Where you might embed

 - Growth: our sales and marketing teams and the partners who bring homeowners to Base, like homebuilders and channel partners. Build what each new market needs to launch, and scale what works from state to state.

 - Deployments: our deployments team and installer partners. Get new crews, paperwork rules, and handoffs right in every state.

 - Utilities: our utility and markets team and the utilities we connect to. Use grid data to find where the grid is strained, decide where batteries do the most good, and shape how we dispatch the fleet.



What you’ll do

 - Learn how the work really gets done, and where it breaks, by working alongside the team or partner

 - Help decide which problems matter most, what to build, and what to fix with process instead of code

 - Build end-to-end software: integrations, internal tools, workflows, data pipelines, and partner-facing products

 - Ship a prototype fast, then harden what works so other teams can rely on it

 - Work with utility partners on grid constraints and data, and build tools that turn that data into decisions about where to deploy batteries and how to command them

 - Launch new states by standing up the partner integrations, workflows, and data each market needs, and make the next launch faster



What you’ll bring

 - 2+ years building production software in product or full-stack engineering roles

 - Strong frontend and full-stack skills, with comfort across modern web apps, APIs, data models, and stateful user experiences

 - Strong product judgment and a track record of turning ambiguous ideas into shipped, useful products

 - Experience in 0-to-1 or fast-moving environments where user needs, product shape, and success metrics are still changing

 - Experience using product analytics, experimentation, and data to guide decisions

 - Intensity and urgency, and a high bar for your own work



Please note: Base is a startup, which means priorities shift and evolve quickly. Your role may expand or change based on the needs of the business at any given time, so the responsibilities listed may not be exhaustive.




OUR VALUES

 - First Principles Thinking: Question assumptions. Principles > rules.

 - Operate at Base Pace: Focus on what matters, act quickly, and learn by doing.

 - Give & Get Feedback: Be direct, be humble, and maintain a growth mindset.

 - Everyone’s an Owner: Follow through on commitments and own results.

 - Strong Opinions, Loosely Held: Drive clarity and make calls with imperfect information.

 - Committed to the Mission: Rebuilding the grid is a big challenge. We work hard because we care deeply about the impact we’re creating. We work in-person. It’s not a 9-to-5. We are all-in.

 - Fun & Optimism Coexist with Grit: Collaboration and celebration coincide with the intensity of building real things.
   
   


DO THE BEST WORK OF YOUR LIFE AT BASE.
